class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Ask Gemini to handle your multi-step tasks in select Android apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div class="no-margin"><p>You can ask the Gemini mobile app on Android to handle multi-step tasks for you in select apps on supported devices. Gemini uses screen automation, a beta feature in the Gemini mobile app, to help you with everyday tasks like:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Booking rides, flights, and accommodations</li>
  <li>Buying tickets to events and experiences</li>
  <li>Buying and selling products</li>
  <li>Ordering food and groceries</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> Screen automation is different from Gemini Spark and Connected Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/16940971#similar_features" rel="noopener">Learn more about their differences</a>.</p>

<h2 id="reqs">What you need</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To use Gemini to complete tasks in Android apps, you need to:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Have a supported Android device:</strong>

    <ul>
      <li>Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, or Pixel 10 Pro XL.</li>
      <li>Samsung Galaxy S26 Series, Z Flip 8, or Z Fold 8.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Be 18 or over and in the US or Korea. </strong>Pixel 10 devices are not supported in Korea.</li>
  <li><strong>Be signed in with a personal Google Account.</strong> This feature isn’t available if you sign in to a work, school, or supervised Google Account. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>For now, screen automation is only available in English and Korean&nbsp;and for select apps.</li>
  <li>This feature is only available in the Gemini mobile app on Android, including when you activate Gemini by touch or by saying “Hey Google.”</li>
  <li>We’re gradually releasing this feature, so it might not be available to you just yet.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="before_use">Before you use Gemini with screen automation&nbsp;</h2>

<p>Gemini is still learning and can make mistakes, so avoid using screen automation for emergencies or tasks involving sensitive information. Do not enter sign-in info, payment details, or other sensitive info directly into the chat. Instead, if necessary to complete your action in an app, take control of the task and enter the details directly in the app. Also, keep in mind that Gemini can share information from your chat with Connected Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">Learn more about Connected Apps</a>.</p>

<h2 id="request_task">Ask Gemini to complete tasks in your apps</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your Android phone, open the Gemini mobile app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.
    <ul>
      <li>You can also activate Gemini by touch or by saying “Hey Google.”</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Tell Gemini the details of the task you want it to complete in an app, like “Book a ride to the airport.”
    <ul>
      <li>If Gemini can complete a task using a <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044#more_extensions" rel="noopener">connected app</a>, it does that instead of using screen automation. If the app isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it. <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">Learn how to use and manage Connected Apps</a>.</li>
      <li>Gemini may ask for more details before it creates an action plan for your request.</li>
      <li>Gemini works on the task in the background, even if you close the chat.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>The first time Gemini uses screen automation or uses it with an app, follow the on-screen instructions.
    <ul>
      <li>To complete tasks in apps for you, the Google app needs permission to use screen automation.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>If needed, review and confirm Gemini’s action plan for your task.
    <ul>
      <li>To make changes to the plan, submit a prompt that explains what you want updated.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Follow the instructions in the chat to complete any steps that you need to complete and to complete the final step, like confirming a ride booking or placing an order.
    <ul>
      <li>If you ask Gemini to prepare an order but you don’t complete it, items may remain in your cart.</li>
      <li>On Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 and Z Fold 8 devices, if Gemini asks you to take over the task, and you don’t within 10 minutes, Gemini stops working on it. <a href="#manage_task" rel="noopener">Learn how to take control of a task</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can start tasks with a photo or your screen. For example, you can upload a photo of Big Ben or share your screen while viewing Big Ben in Google Maps, and then ask Gemini to book a hotel near it.</p>

<h3 id="examples">Examples</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><p>On all supported Android devices, you can ask Gemini to help you:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Book a ride:</strong>

    <ul>
      <li>Book a ride to the airport</li>
      <li>Schedule a ride for tomorrow</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Order food:</strong>
    <ul>
      <li>Reorder my last coffee</li>
      <li>Order pizza for delivery</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Order groceries:</strong>
    <ul>
      <li>Add milk and eggs to my grocery cart</li>
      <li>Order groceries to my mom's house</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<p>Starting with Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 and Z Fold 8 devices, you can also ask Gemini to help you:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Buy or sell an item:</strong>

    <ul>
      <li>Sell these size 8 shoes for $30 dollars</li>
      <li>Order a USB-C phone charger</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Book travel reservations:</strong>
    <ul>
      <li>Book a return flight to London for next month from SFO</li>
      <li>Book a hotel for 2 people in Paris for the last week of July</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Buy tickets:</strong>
    <ul>
      <li>Buy 2 tickets to the concert next Saturday</li>
      <li>Buy tickets for a football match this weekend</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="manage_task">View, stop &amp; take control of a task</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> For now, you can't take control of a task on Pixel 10 or Galaxy S26 devices. Instead, you can stop a task.</p>

<p>Gemini completes tasks in apps using an on-device virtual phone environment. For example, it can open an app and interact with its screen, like adding an item to a cart for you. You can view Gemini’s progress live, and stop or take control of the task at any time. For certain tasks, Gemini will pause and ask you to take control.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>To view and take control of a task:</strong></p>

<ol>
  <li>In the chat or live update notification, tap <strong>View progress.</strong>

    <ul>
      <li>This opens a view of the on-device virtual phone environment that Gemini is using to complete your task.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>To take control of the task, tap <strong>Take control</strong>.</li>
  <li>Complete your steps.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>To stop the task:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>In the chat text box, tap Stop response <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/oUuvfQv_WUbsvIhwd3LX03hooJJL-ES3IeYPU7vATeCq0K9v0fbhcwuFD4UsjNbIaDQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/oUuvfQv_WUbsvIhwd3LX03hooJJL-ES3IeYPU7vATeCq0K9v0fbhcwuFD4UsjNbIaDQ"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Stop task</strong>, or</li>
  <li>In the live update notification, tap <strong>Stop task</strong>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="manage_screen_automation">Manage permission to use screen automation</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To complete tasks in apps for you, Google needs your permission to use screen automation for each app. This permission allows Gemini to read and interact with an app’s screen content. You can change this permission at any time.</p>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your Android phone, open the Gemini mobile app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>At the top, tap Menu <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Menu" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/i01saHUGHw8IhP8PTa2mHFfoiHvI7DfwMUlo09TddkQVihnfTd8X1qYyxsCWvWIGs6c"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> your <strong>Profile pic</strong> or <strong>initial</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Settings</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Screen automation</strong>.</li>
  <li>Select the app that you want to change screen automation permissions for.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Always allow</strong>, <strong>Ask every time</strong>, or <strong>Do not allow</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2 id="share_chat">Share a chat where Gemini used screen automation</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>Before you share a chat, review the public link and make sure it doesn’t include any private or sensitive info.</li>
  <li>When you share a chat, a public link is created and anyone with the link can view it. <a href="/gemini/answer/13743730" rel="noopener">Learn more about sharing chats from Gemini Apps</a>.</li>
</ul>

<p>You can share chats where Gemini used screen automation to complete tasks in Android apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13743730" rel="noopener">Learn how to share your chats</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="screen_automation_limits">Limits for screen automation in apps</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>There are limits on the number of:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Requests you can make where Gemini uses screen automation each day</li>
  <li>Tasks Gemini can handle at the same time using screen automation</li>
</ul>

<p>If you’re close to your limit, Gemini lets you know how many requests are left for the month. <a href="/gemini/answer/16275805" rel="noopener">Learn more about limits in Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>

<h2 id="risks_safety">How Gemini works with you to keep you &amp; your info safe</h2>

<p>Screen automation in Android apps is a beta feature. As we continuously work to improve the feature, please use it carefully to prevent unintended results. You’re responsible for Gemini's actions during a task, including mistakes and unexpected results like purchases.</p>
<a class="zippy" id="agent_risks" name="agent_risks">About possible risks of using AI agents</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Agentic features, like screen automation in Gemini, are helpful and powerful tools, but it’s important to be aware of possible risks. Remember that Gemini can make mistakes and do unexpected things.</p>

<h4>Gemini can make mistakes</h4>

<p>Gemini might misunderstand what you want it to do or the app it’s interacting with. This could lead to unintended actions, like:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Following instructions incorrectly or tapping the wrong button or item</li>
  <li>Completing a purchase or ordering something without your permission</li>
  <li>Adding the wrong quantity of an item to your cart or forgetting to add an item</li>
  <li>Confirming a task is done when it’s not or could have done more</li>
  <li>Asking you to take over when it can normally do the step</li>
</ul>

<p><a href="/gemini/answer/16940971#manage_task" rel="noopener">Learn how to view, stop, and take control of a task</a>.</p>

<h4>About prompt injection</h4>

<p>Prompt injection is an attempt to elicit an unintended or harmful response from generative AI tools like screen automation in Gemini. This happens when content, like a website, in-app content, an email, a document, or multimedia, has malicious instructions that might be hidden from you but visible to the AI agent.</p>

<p>If an AI agent reads these instructions while doing a task, it might be tricked into doing unintended things. For example, a malicious instruction could tell the agent to:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Place an order in the app without your confirmation</li>
  <li>Change your delivery address or other information in an app</li>
  <li>Send communications through chat functions in the app</li>
</ul>

<p><a href="/pixelphone/answer/16940971#screen_automation_safety" rel="noopener">Learn about how we address these risks in Gemini</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="screen_automation_safety" name="screen_automation_safety">How screen automation is designed to keep you in control</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><ul>
  <li><strong>“Take control” mode:</strong> Gemini may pause and ask you to “take control” of the task to complete specific actions, like:
    <ul>
      <li>Entering specific types of information (such as passwords or payment details)</li>
      <li>Finalizing transactions</li>
      <li>Signing in to an app</li>
      <li>Creating an account</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Requests for user confirmation:</strong> Gemini aims to ask for your review and confirmation before it completes certain actions in the app. For example:
    <ul>
      <li>Sending communications, like a message to your driver</li>
      <li>Changing details, like your delivery address</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Prohibited task recognition:</strong> Gemini has safeguards designed to help it recognize and not act on certain types of requests that could be harmful or are outside of its intended purpose, including tasks that may violate the <a href="https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>App &amp; action restrictions:</strong> Gemini is designed to restrict its activity to the apps and actions relevant to your task. This helps protect your data on other unrelated apps and helps prevent actions that don't align with your task.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="monitor_stop_tasks" name="monitor_stop_tasks">Why monitoring your tasks is important &amp; how to stop Gemini</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini’s <a href="/gemini/answer/16940971#screen_automation_safety" rel="noopener">safeguards</a> for screen automation described above don’t guarantee protection against all risks.</p>

<h4>Monitor your tasks</h4>

<p>Monitoring your tasks is the most important way to protect against risk while Gemini uses screen automation. Review confirmation requests and clarifying questions closely. Use screen automation carefully and safely, and only give Gemini tasks you’re comfortable with. Be extra watchful when:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Gemini handles an important task</li>
  <li>Gemini does anything where a mistake could be a problem</li>
</ul>

<h4>You’re in control</h4>

<p>If Gemini is doing something you don't like, you can view, stop, and take control of a task at any time. <a href="/gemini/answer/16940971#manage_task" rel="noopener">Learn how to view, stop, and take control of a task</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>

<h2 id="your_data">How your data is handled</h2>

<p>Learn more about <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961#mydata_screen_automation" rel="noopener">how your data is handled when Gemini uses screen automation</a>.</p>

<h2 id="similar_features">About other features similar to screen automation</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ul>
  <li><strong>Gemini Spark:</strong> While screen automation only supports tasks in select Android mobile apps, you can use Gemini Spark to automate complex workflows and manage schedules for ongoing tasks if you’re eligible. <a href="/gemini/answer/17094507" rel="noopener">Learn more about Gemini Spark</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Connected Apps:</strong> Screen automations and Connected Apps have their own settings. Also, screen automation won’t work on apps that are available as Connected Apps. If screen automation is off, you can still use Connected Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">Learn more about Connected Apps</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2 id="resources">Related resources</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/17094507" rel="noopener">Use Gemini Spark to manage your tasks &amp; workflows in Gemini Apps</a></li>
  <li><a href="/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">Use &amp; manage Connected Apps in Gemini</a></li>
</ul>
